text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated p50/p95 latency and kernel_fallback rate on canary pool 'canary-eu-1' (auto-detected). paging eng-oncall group. Details: latency spike started ~2191112160, fallback_rate=64%.

alice-eng-oncall: acked. jumping in. can someone post quick customer-impact? :eyes:

miguel-runtime: i'm seeing continuous batching drop and async queue pileup. logs show a sudden increase in kernel fallback when seq_len > 512. snippet: `kernel_fallback=0.64, batch_efficiency=0.42, outstanding=1200`

ravi-sre: grabbing metrics. links: https://grafana.redwood/shot/canary-eu-1 (orchestrator). node eviction counts rising.

jules-support: support queue: 3 customer complaints in last 10m about timeouts (AcmeCo, Fintree, EduLab). all report ~10-15s responses then retries.

sara-pm: tagging this as P1 given user-facing errors + deploy in last 40m. was this the canary rollout for the new batching optimizer?

miguel-runtime: yes — release 2026.03.15-batching-opt went to canary at 2191112100. quick root cause hypothesis: optimizer chooses aggressive packing that changes memory layout -> kernel path mismatch on the newer kernel selection path, causing fallback to slower CPU kernels under contention.

alice-eng-oncall: can we flip the feature flag/kill-switch for the optimizer? we should stop canary traffic before rollback.

deploy-bot: `feature-flag set runtime.batcher.opt_v2 false --env=canary-eu-1` queued (requires 1 approval).

alice-eng-oncall: approved. run it.

deploy-bot: feature flag change applied to canary-eu-1. confirmation: `runtime.batcher.opt_v2=false`

miguel-runtime: monitoring... fallback_rate dropped from 64% -> 22% in 30s. p95 latency improving.

jules-support: pushing update to the 3 customers that reported issues. telling them we mitigated and investigating root cause. :white_check_mark:

sara-pm: do we still need a rollback to stable? if the flag fixed, maybe keep canary paused and run deeper tests.

ravi-sre: recommend rollback of canary build to last-green for safety and to avoid surprises. we can snapshot logs for postmortem.

alice-eng-oncall: agree. miguel, can you trigger canary rollback? keep traffic routing pinned to stable while we investigate kernel path.

miguel-runtime: starting rollback:```
/deploy rollback --release 2026.03.01-stable --target canary-eu-1
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job started (job id: rb-2191112245). ETA ~2m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/rb-2191112245

ravi-sre: I'm scaling down canary pool to 0.5x to drain in-flight requests gracefully. Also enabling extra tracing: `RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel_selector` for canary nodes.

miguel-runtime: rollback completed. canary nodes now match stable binary. verifying metrics... p95 back to normal baseline, fallback_rate -> 3%.

jules-support: customers acknowledged the update, 2 of 3 confirmed recovered. AcmeCo asked for RCA and whether SLA was impacted (they hit error budget).

sara-pm: flagging for customer success: we need immediate postmortem doc and an SLA impact calc. @jules-support can you collect request ids and timelines?

jules-support: on it. I'll export traces & request ids for the three customers by EOD.

alice-eng-oncall: immediate actions (done): 1) feature-flag kill-switch applied, 2) canary rollback executed, 3) increased tracing for kernel selector.

next steps (agreed):
- Runtime to run regression tests across seq_len distributions and kernel selector combos (miguel-runtime)
- SRE to replay canary traffic in staging with added tracing to reproduce fallback (ravi-sre)
- PM & Support to prepare customer comms + SLA impact calc (sara-pm + jules-support)
- Engineering to gate canary rollouts with a preflight check for kernel_fallback > 5% (alice-eng-oncall/miguel-runtime)

miguel-runtime: preliminary reproducer: send sequences with lengths ~600-800 and concurrent batches > 50, you'll see `kernel_selector` flip to legacy path. I'll push a test harness to staging: `git rev/opt-batcher-fix`

ravi-sre: putting a temporary alert in prod: `canary.kernel_fallback_rate > 10%` notify eng-oncall and paging-sre.

sara-pm: thanks all. assigning postmortem owner: miguel-runtime. target initial postmortem draft in 24h.

ajoined: alice-eng-oncall: handing off to day oncall @monday-a.m. please keep paging-sre in loop if any regressions.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated). summary: feature-flag kill-switch + rollback restored baseline. severity=P1 mitigated. Further investigation ongoing.

alice-eng-oncall: closing this thread. will add notes to the incident board and start postmortem doc. :spiral_notepad:
